en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from Abu Maryam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding the one with a share who forgave, so his forgiveness is allowed; and he<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding four brothers, one of them forgave, he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He would be given the wergild, and from the remaining ones, (the wergild) would be raised from them by the share of the one who forgave’.
